title: Bounded return walk
statement: For the designated machine with parameter $K_0$, oracle $\mathrm{orc}:\{0,\ldots,3\}\times\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}$, input $x$, and natural bounds $B,P$, let $st$ be a memory access site, $b$ a Boolean, $k$ a natural number, $S$ a machine state, $M:\mathbb Z\to\{0,1\}$ a memory marking, and $p\in\mathbb Z$. If $S.T_2=k$, every register of $S$ is at most $B$, $0\le p-k$, and $p\le P$, then the machine has a finite run from the return-walk configuration at $st$ carrying bit $b$, with state $S$, marking $M$, and head position $p$, to the configuration at the corresponding exit with state $S$ except that $T_2$ is set to zero, the same marking, and head position $p-k$. At every configuration strictly before the endpoint, the register-instruction precondition holds, every register is at most $B$, and the memory head lies between $0$ and $P$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural parameter $K_0$ and the designated machine with that parameter
Oracle from four indices and Boolean strings to Booleans
Integer head position $p$ with $0\le p-k$ and $p\le P$
Every register of $S$ is at most $B$
replaced:
Fix the designated machine $A(K_0)$, oracle
$\mathrm{orc}:\mathrm{Fin}(4)\to\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}$, input $x$, and natural bounds
$B,P$. For every memory access site $st$, bit $b$, walk length $k$, register state $S$,
memory marking $M:\mathbb Z\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and head position $p$,
if $S.T2=k$, every register of $S$ is at most $B$, $0\le p-k$, and $p\le P$, then the
machine can run from the configuration at the return-walk phase for $st,b$, with state
$S$, marking $M$, and head $p$, to the configuration at the corresponding exit with the
same marking, state $S$ except that $T2$ is set to zero, and head position $p-k$. Every
configuration before the endpoint satisfies the guard: its register-instruction
precondition holds and all register values are at most $B$, while its memory head lies
between $0$ and $P$.
